result.summary: The page is mostly well rendered, but one clear visual defect stands out: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. The rest of the layout (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom navigation) appears intact.

issues.description: The cover image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' is not displayed. A flat grey box with a broken-image icon appears instead, while the other restaurant cards show their food photos.
issues.suggestion: Check that the image URL/asset for this restaurant is valid and loads correctly. Add a branded fallback image (e.g. a cuisine-type illustration or the restaurant logo) and retry logic so a broken-image icon is never shown to users.
